name: K7
description: Self-hosted media server for movies, series and music, for family and friends

paths.name: Data
paths.description: The database, K7 settings and keys, artwork, logs and the transcoding cache.

paths.name: Media
paths.description: Your movies, series and music. Point it at the folder that holds them, like /mnt/cache/media with Movies, Series and Music inside. You can add more folders in the app settings, at any container path like /movies or /tv. K7 sees each one at that path.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: K7 web app, API and video streams, published on host as 6186

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: The user id that owns the app's files. 500 is the MOS default.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: The group id that owns the app's files. 500 is the MOS default.

variables.name: PUBLIC_URL
variables.description: The address of K7. Watching works from every device with the default. For sign-in with OIDC or sharing with other K7 servers, change it to http://YOUR-SERVER-IP:6186 or your https address. Keep the port at 6186.

variables.name: ADMIN_USERNAME
variables.description: The user name of the admin account made on first start.

variables.name: ADMIN_PASSWORD
variables.description: The admin password, used only on first start. Leave it blank and the app makes a random one, shown in the app log and saved in the data folder. Your own needs 10 or more characters with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter and a number. Change it later in K7's account settings.
